_comment: Single source of truth for TinkerWithMe PREMIUM courses. premium.html renders cards from this and generate_premium.py renders one branded outline PDF per course into proposals/<id>.pdf. Keep prices in whole KES.

courses.title: Smart Home Builder
prereqs: Traffic light simulation OR Button controlled LED (free)
courses.summary: Kids build a working smart home model with three integrated systems, wired into one house.

sessions.title: Smart Lighting
sessions.desc: Photoresistor + relay auto-lights rooms at dusk; a PIR motion sensor activates hallway lights.

sessions.title: Climate Control
sessions.desc: DHT11 temperature sensor triggers a fan via relay; an LCD displays the current temperature.

sessions.title: Security System
sessions.desc: Ultrasonic door sensor + buzzer alarm + servo-powered door lock, all wired into one house model.

courses.takeaway: Cardboard smart house model with all circuits installed
courses.pitch: Your child builds a miniature version of the smart home tech you see advertised — and actually understands how it works.

courses.title: Self-Driving Car
courses.summary: Build a chassis-based car that navigates on its own, finishing with a race day.

sessions.title: Motorised Chassis
sessions.desc: DC motors, an L298N motor driver, and basic forward/reverse/turn controls.

sessions.title: Line Follower
sessions.desc: IR sensors detect a black track so the car follows it autonomously.

sessions.title: Obstacle Avoidance
sessions.desc: An HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor lets the car detect and steer around objects. Final race day!

courses.pitch: The technology behind Waymo and Tesla — built from scratch by your 12-year-old.

courses.title: Smart City
courses.summary: Teams of 3–4 each build one city subsystem, then connect them on a shared city board.

sessions.title: Street Lights
sessions.desc: Photoresistor-activated LEDs that turn on at "night".

sessions.title: Traffic System
sessions.desc: Multi-intersection traffic lights with a pedestrian crossing button.

sessions.title: Parking Garage
sessions.desc: Ultrasonic sensor counts cars in/out; an LED sign shows FULL/OPEN.

sessions.title: Weather Station
sessions.desc: DHT11 + LDR display conditions on an LCD.

courses.takeaway: Their subsystem module + a group photo of the full city
courses.pitch: Kids collaborate like real city engineers — each team owns a piece, then they integrate it all.

courses.title: Robot Arm & Claw
courses.summary: Assemble and program a 3-DOF robot arm with a gripper claw and a joystick controller.

sessions.title: Build & Wire
sessions.desc: Assemble a 3-DOF (degree-of-freedom) arm using SG90 servos and build a joystick controller with two analog sticks.

sessions.title: Program & Challenge
sessions.desc: Calibrate movement ranges and add a gripper claw servo. Challenge: pick up and sort coloured objects by zone.

courses.pitch: The same principles behind factory robots and surgical arms — in your child's hands.

courses.title: Wearable Tech Lab
courses.summary: Kids design and build a wearable gadget they wire, code and wear home.

sessions.title: Build
sessions.desc: Sew or attach a NeoPixel LED strip to a wristband or cap.

sessions.title: Program
sessions.desc: Program light patterns: rainbow cycle, heartbeat pulse, and colour-react-to-sound using a sound sensor module.

sessions.title: Personalise
sessions.desc: Finish and personalise the wearable with craft materials.

courses.pitch: Part fashion, part engineering. They design it, wire it, code it, and wear it home.

courses.title: IoT Garden Monitor
courses.summary: Build a sensor kit that keeps a real seedling alive, then automate its care.

sessions.title: Sense
sessions.desc: Soil moisture sensor + DHT11 (humidity/temp) + LDR (sunlight), with readings on an LCD. Plant a real seedling.

sessions.title: Automate
sessions.desc: Set thresholds — if the soil is dry a relay triggers a small water pump; a buzzer alerts when conditions are off.

courses.takeaway: Sensor kit + a seedling in a monitored pot
courses.pitch: STEM meets nature. They build tech that actually keeps a plant alive.

courses.title: Musical Instrument Builder
courses.summary: Build a playable electronic instrument on a breadboard.

sessions.title: Ultrasonic theremin
sessions.desc: Hand distance controls the pitch.

sessions.title: Button piano
sessions.desc: Eight tactile buttons mapped to a full octave.

sessions.title: Tempo & recording
sessions.desc: Tempo control with a potentiometer; record and play back a short melody.

courses.takeaway: Their instrument circuit on a breadboard
courses.pitch: Music + code + electronics = the coolest instrument they've ever made.

courses.title: AI Game Designer
courses.summary: Design and build a playable game using AI tools.

sessions.title: Morning — Design
sessions.desc: Use ChatGPT to brainstorm concepts, write rules and generate character backstories; use DALL-E for character art and board/card designs.

sessions.title: Afternoon — Build
sessions.desc: Create the game in Scratch or a no-code platform, add AI-generated sound effects, then playtest with peers and iterate.

courses.takeaway: Playable game + a design portfolio PDF
courses.pitch: They don't just play games — they create them, using the same AI tools professionals use.

courses.title: AI Movie Studio
courses.summary: Produce a short film powered entirely by AI, then premiere it for parents.

sessions.title: Script
sessions.desc: ChatGPT-assisted story writing and dialogue.

sessions.title: Visuals
sessions.desc: AI image generation for storyboards and backgrounds.

sessions.title: Audio
sessions.desc: AI-generated music, sound effects and optional voice narration.

sessions.title: Edit & Premiere
sessions.desc: Assemble in CapCut or a similar free editor, then screen the films for parents at pickup.

courses.takeaway: Their finished short film (shared via link)
courses.pitch: A full film production — written, illustrated, scored, and edited — in one day.

courses.title: AI Entrepreneur
courses.summary: Launch a mini-business using AI tools, ending with a pitch to a panel.

sessions.title: Idea & Brand
sessions.desc: AI-assisted market research, business-name generation, logo design (DALL-E/Canva AI) and a brand colour palette.

sessions.title: Product & Marketing
sessions.desc: Create a product mockup or digital product, write marketing copy with ChatGPT, and design social media posts.

sessions.title: Pitch Day
sessions.desc: Build a pitch deck, rehearse with AI feedback, and present to a panel (parents invited).

courses.takeaway: Brand kit + pitch deck + digital product prototype
courses.pitch: Business school for kids. They leave with a brand, a product, and a pitch.

courses.title: Deepfake Detective & AI Safety
courses.summary: Critical thinking meets cutting-edge AI: spot fakes, understand misinformation, and write a personal AI safety code.

sessions.title: Spot the fakes
sessions.desc: Detect deepfake images, videos and audio using detective techniques.

sessions.title: Trace misinformation
sessions.desc: Understand how misinformation spreads by tracing a fake story's path.

sessions.title: Build a classifier
sessions.desc: Build a "Fake or Real?" quiz using Teachable Machine (image classifier).

sessions.title: AI Safety Code & debate
sessions.desc: Draft a personal AI Safety Code, then debate: "Should AI-generated art be allowed in school?"

courses.takeaway: AI Safety Code poster + Fake-or-Real classifier
courses.pitch: Every child will encounter deepfakes. This session teaches them to think before they believe.

courses.title: AI Music Producer
courses.summary: Go deeper than the free session and produce a real EP with cover art.

sessions.title: Compose
sessions.desc: Use Suno/Udio to generate tracks across genres, learn song structure (verse, chorus, bridge), and remix and layer.

sessions.title: Produce
sessions.desc: Mix multiple AI tracks, add voice recordings, create album art with DALL-E, and "release" on a class playlist.

courses.pitch: They produce an actual album. Genre, lyrics, cover art — all created by your child with AI.

courses.title: Computer Vision Explorer
courses.summary: Build on the free Teachable Machine session to make a working computer-vision app.

sessions.title: Advanced Classifiers
sessions.desc: Train models to sort waste (recyclable vs. landfill), identify plant species, or read hand gestures. Discuss training-data quality and bias.

sessions.title: Real-World Application
sessions.desc: Build a gesture-controlled presentation (wave = next slide) or a waste-sorting advisor, and connect the classifier to a simple web app.

courses.takeaway: Working computer-vision app they can demo
courses.pitch: Self-driving cars see the world through computer vision. Your child just built their own version.

courses.title: AI for Social Good
courses.summary: Solve a real community problem with AI, ending with a pitch and a Changemaker badge.

sessions.title: Research
sessions.desc: Pick a local challenge (water access, matatu routes, waste management, school safety) and use AI to research, interview and map the problem.

sessions.title: Prototype
sessions.desc: Build an AI-assisted solution — a chatbot, a classifier, a data dashboard, or an awareness campaign with AI-generated content.

sessions.title: Present
sessions.desc: Pitch the solution to peers and parents. Best project wins the "TinkerWith_ Changemaker" badge.

courses.pitch: AI isn't just about tech — it's about impact. They tackle a real problem their community faces.

courses.title: Smart City 2.0 — AI-Powered
courses.summary: The ultimate crossover: build an Arduino smart city, then give it an AI brain.

sessions.title: Day 1 — Build
sessions.desc: Teams assemble Arduino smart-city modules (traffic, parking, street lights, environment sensors).

sessions.title: Day 2 — Add Intelligence
sessions.desc: Use Teachable Machine to add a "vision" layer — a camera classifies traffic density and the AI recommends light timing. ChatGPT generates a city-planning report from sensor data. Teams present their AI-enhanced city to parents.

courses.takeaway: Their city module + an AI analysis report
courses.pitch: Hardware meets AI. Two days, one smart city, built and brain-powered by kids.
